lines.text: Many learners say: My phone is bad.
Broken means it does not work.

data.why: Broken means it does not work.

quiz.stem: My phone does not work. It is ___.

native.tip: 中文说“手机坏了”，“坏”容易对应 bad，但东西不能用了要说 broken。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “My phone is bad.”😅 “坏了”对应 broken，不是 bad：“My phone is broken.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“My phone is broken.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Bad means not good, but broken means it does not work.
en.caption: Do you say “My phone is bad.” 😅 Bad means not good, but broken means it does not work: “My phone is broken.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
